conservation_status.note_en: No species-level global IUCN assessment was found; Not Evaluated is not a measure of abundance or safety.
conservation_status.note_zh: 未找到该物种的全球IUCN物种级评估；未评估不代表数量多或安全。

description.en: One of the largest butterflies in the world, with dazzling, iridescent blue wings that flash like a neon sign in the rainforest canopy.
description.zh: 世界上最大的蝴蝶之一，拥有耀眼、闪烁着虹彩的蓝色翅膀，在雨林树冠层中它就像一块闪烁的霓虹招牌。

anatomy.en: Their wingspan can reach up to 20 centimeters. The brilliant blue isn't actually a pigment—it's created by the microscopic scales on their wings reflecting light! The underside of their wings is brown with large eyespots for camouflage.
anatomy.zh: 它们的翼展可达20厘米。那绚烂的蓝色根本不是因为体内有色素——而是由它们翅膀上的微观鳞片反射光线形成的！它们翅膀的底面则是棕色的，并长有用于伪装的巨大眼斑。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Blue morphos do not drink flower nectar. Instead, they use sensors on their legs to 'taste' rotting fruit, tree sap, and even fermenting fungi found on the forest floor.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 大蓝闪蝶并不吸食花蜜。相反，它们利用腿部的传感器去「品尝」森林地表上腐烂的水果、树液甚至发酵的真菌。

habitat_and_distribution.en: They are native to the tropical forests of Central and South America, particularly widespread throughout the Amazon. They spend most of their time flying rapidly through the understory.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 它们原产于中美洲和南美洲的热带森林，特别是在亚马逊地区分布广泛。它们大部分时间都在森林底层急速飞行。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and every polygon coordinate are retained exactly. The polygon remains labelled approximate because reusable authoritative boundary geometry was not established in this review.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放级别和每个多边形坐标均完全保留。由于本次复核未取得可复用的权威边界几何，该多边形继续标为近似范围。

content_review.notes: Taxonomy, current global status, legacy bilingual sections, image identity criteria and unchanged habitat geometry reviewed for legacy QC batch 03B–03E.

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Development proceeds through species-specific immature stages before the reproductive adult stage. Temperature, host resources and colony structure can change timing, so unsupported precision is avoided.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 发育经过该物种特有的未成熟阶段，之后进入可繁殖成虫期。温度、寄主资源和群体结构会改变时间，因此避免没有来源的精确数字。

ecological_role.en: As a frugivore in forest habitat, this species transfers energy through its food web; the detailed effects depend on local abundance, prey or food plants, and interactions described by the cited ecology source.
ecological_role.zh: 作为森林生境中的食果性，该物种在食物网中传递能量；具体影响取决于当地数量、猎物或食物植物，以及所引生态来源描述的相互作用。

threats.en: A missing global assessment creates uncertainty; it must not be converted into a claim that the species is secure.
threats.zh: 缺少全球评估意味着存在不确定性；不能据此宣称该物种安全。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality, and update management when population monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威所确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在种群监测或分类变化时更新管理。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes may share color or body shape. Confirm records with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked source rather than a filename or single feature.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享颜色或体形。记录应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元来源确认，不能只凭文件名或单一特征。

communication_and_senses.en: The species uses the sensory channels available to its class—vision, sound, chemical cues, touch or vibration—in combinations shaped by its habitat. The cited species account should be used before assigning a specific call or signal.
communication_and_senses.zh: 该物种会组合使用其类群具备的视觉、声音、化学信号、触觉或振动等感官通道，具体组合受生境塑造。指定某种叫声或信号前，应查阅所引物种资料。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population must not be presented as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、迁移、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。不能把某一种群的日期写成全球统一规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback, nest or den disturbance, and any approach that changes natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放叫声、干扰巢穴或洞穴，以及任何改变自然行为的接近。

evolution.en: Morpho menelaus is placed in Morpho, family Nymphalidae, order Lepidoptera. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy source.
evolution.zh: Morpho menelaus归入闪蝶属、蛱蝶科、鳞翅目。本次复核遵循分类来源所引的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs may narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Fresh sign near a dangerous or sensitive animal requires distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。危险或敏感动物附近的新鲜痕迹意味着应保持距离。

text.en: Its accepted scientific name in this review is Morpho menelaus.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Morpho menelaus。

text.en: Not Evaluated means a global species assessment was not available, not that extinction risk is zero.
text.zh: 未评估表示缺少全球物种评估，不代表灭绝风险为零。

text.en: The map retains the previous approximate range geometry and does not claim a newly verified boundary.
text.zh: 地图保留原有近似范围几何，并不声称这是新核实的边界。
